name: Mangos Cafe
blurb: A bar, hookah lounge and restaurant on Smith Place — where Columbus comes to unwind, celebrate and linger since 2011.
about: Mangos Cafe is located in downtown Columbus' Short North Arts District, about a 7-minute drive from Ohio State University. Our large patio is fully covered and open all year long, with heaters to keep you warm through the winter. We also have a private room available to rent for parties, meetings and special events.

menu.title: Alcoholic Drinks & Cocktails
menu.intro: At Mangos Cafe we take the drinks we serve very seriously. Our certified bartenders will go out of their way to find the best drink for your food and your mood — a full bar of whiskey, tequila, vodka, scotch, cocktails, beer and seltzers. Ready to discover your happy hour?

items.name: Whiskey Flight
items.description: A guided tasting from our whiskey selection
items.details: Three pours from our top shelf, served with tasting notes so you can find your favorite. Choose from bourbon, Scotch or rye — our bartenders are happy to walk you through every sip.

items.name: House Margarita
items.details: Shaken to order with fresh lime juice and a salted rim. Our most-ordered classic since 2011 — clean, balanced and dangerously easy to drink.

items.name: Mango Mule
items.details: Our tropical twist on the Moscow Mule, served ice-cold in a copper mug with fresh mango and a ginger kick. A Mangos original you won't find anywhere else.

items.name: Craft Beer & Seltzers
items.details: Ask your server what's on tap tonight — the lineup rotates weekly with Columbus local breweries and seasonal imports. Hard seltzers and non-alcoholic options also available.

items.name: Tequila Sunrise
items.details: A layered pour of tequila, fresh orange juice and grenadine that looks as good as it tastes. Best enjoyed slowly so the layers hold as long as possible.

items.name: Old Fashioned
items.details: Stirred over a single large cube with a wide orange twist and a dash of aromatic bitters. Timeless, bold and strong — exactly as it should be.

menu.title: Hookah & Tobacco Flavors
menu.intro: Exceptional hookah service on Custom LED Tipsy Hookahs and All-Glass LED Hookahs, with house blend flavors and many more — a Mangos signature since day one.

items.name: Double Apple
items.details: The flavor that started it all — rich, sweet and smooth from the first draw to the last coal. Our most-reordered flavor, every single night since 2011.

items.name: Mint Chill
items.details: A crisp, cooling mint that keeps every session refreshing. Great on its own or mixed with Double Apple for a classic combo our regulars swear by.

items.name: Blue Mist
items.details: A house blend of mixed berries and bright citrus, light on the exhale and fruity all the way through. A great choice if you're trying hookah for the first time.

items.name: Grape Ice
items.details: Sweet grape layered over an icy cool finish. Smooth and consistent across the entire session — a crowd pleaser every time.

items.name: Custom House Blend
items.description: Build your own with our staff
items.details: Tell us what you like and our staff will craft a personal blend right at your table. Mix and match from our full flavor menu — no limit on combinations.

items.name: LED Tipsy Hookah
items.details: Upgrade any flavor to our signature all-glass LED setup — the hookah glows with the music and the mood of the room. A show in itself that turns heads every time.

menu.title: Food and Beverages
menu.intro: A delicious food menu to go with your night out — wings, fries and shareables, plus smoothies, coffee and tea for whenever you need to slow back down.

items.name: Chicken Wings
items.details: Tossed in your choice of Buffalo, BBQ or lemon pepper, served with ranch or blue cheese on the side. Our kitchen's most-ordered bite — crispy, saucy and meant for sharing.

items.name: Loaded Fries
items.details: Crispy fries piled high with melted cheese, our house sauce and fresh scallions. Perfect to share with the table — gone faster than you'd expect.

items.name: Mozzarella Sticks
items.details: Golden and crispy outside, gooey and melted inside — served with a side of marinara. Hard to stop at just one order.

items.name: Fried Pickles
items.details: Crunchy dill pickle chips, battered and fried to a perfect golden crisp, served with a cool ranch dip. A Short North staple that pairs with everything.

items.name: Mango Smoothie
items.details: Fresh mango blended thick and cold — a Mangos staple since day one. No added sugar, just real fruit. A good way to pace yourself between rounds.

items.name: Coffee & Tea
items.details: Freshly brewed to order, hot or iced — your call. A good way to end a long night or fuel the next round. Ask your server about tonight's tea selection.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.intro: Fifteen years in the Short North and still going. Here's what regulars and first-timers have to say about a night at Mangos Cafe.

items.author: Danielle R.
items.text: The patio is the whole reason I keep coming back — covered and heated, so it works in February just as well as July. Bartenders actually know what they're doing and the hookah service is the best in the Short North.

items.author: Marcus T.
items.text: Booked the private room for my brother's birthday and they took care of everything. Wings and loaded fries kept coming, the LED hookahs were a hit, and the staff never made us feel rushed. Easy ten out of ten.

items.author: Priya S.
items.text: Great spot to land after class — about seven minutes from campus. The mango mule is genuinely excellent. Gets busy on Friday nights so get there before ten if you want the patio.

items.author: Andre W.
items.text: Been coming here since 2013 and it hasn't lost a step. Double apple is still the move. Feels like the one place downtown that never turned into something else.

items.author: Kayla M.
items.text: Asked the bartender to build me something with whiskey and no sweetness and he nailed it on the first try. That's rare. Good music, not so loud you can't talk.

promotions.title: Offers
